brief: Compare a fund’s stated objective and holdings with the exposure a learner intended to obtain.

title.pt-BR: O fundo combina com a meta?

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Fund Fit"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿El fondo coincide con la meta?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "O fundo combina com a meta?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare a fund’s stated objective and holdings with the exposure a learner intended to obtain.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A fund can follow its own objective perfectly and still be wrong for the exposure you intended.
instruction.misconception: A fund’s attractive name or successful performance proves it matches the learner’s desired exposure.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: You want many industries. A fund holds only energy shares, so it does not provide the broad exposure you wanted.
One industry does not meet the stated broad-exposure goal.
The documents reveal what exposure each fund seeks and holds.
Performance does not change the stated exposure mismatch.
B’s holdings match the geographic scope requested.
A policy change can alter the exposure being purchased.
The holdings differ in both asset type and currency.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A fund can follow its own objective perfectly and still be wrong for the exposure you intended.

es-MX.line: Un fondo puede cumplir su objetivo y aun así no coincidir con la exposición que buscabas.

pt-BR.line: Um fundo pode cumprir sua meta e ainda não combinar com o risco que você pretendia assumir.

en-US.line: You want many industries. A fund holds only energy shares, so it does not provide the broad exposure you wanted.

es-MX.line: Buscas varias industrias. Un fondo solo tiene acciones energéticas, así que no ofrece la exposición amplia que querías.

pt-BR.line: Você busca vários setores. Um fundo só tem ações de energia, então não oferece a variedade que você queria.

en-US.scene: The stated goal is broad industry exposure. The fund owns only bank shares.
help: Compare the holdings with the actual goal.

feedback.met: One industry does not meet the stated broad-exposure goal.
feedback.not_yet: Compare the holdings with the actual goal.

es-MX.scene: La meta indica exposición a varias industrias. El fondo solo posee acciones bancarias.
help: Compara las inversiones con la meta real.

feedback.met: Una industria no cumple la meta de exposición amplia.
feedback.not_yet: Compara las inversiones con la meta real.

pt-BR.scene: A meta pede vários setores. O fundo só possui ações de bancos.
help: Compare os ativos com a meta real.

feedback.met: Um setor não atende à meta de variedade.
feedback.not_yet: Compare os ativos com a meta real.

en-US.scene: A learner wants short-term debt exposure. Two funds have unclear names.

feedback.met: The documents reveal what exposure each fund seeks and holds.

es-MX.scene: Buscan exposición a deuda de corto plazo. Dos fondos tienen nombres poco claros.
help: Lee más allá de la etiqueta.

feedback.met: Los documentos revelan qué exposición busca y tiene cada fondo.
feedback.not_yet: Lee más allá de la etiqueta.

pt-BR.scene: Buscam dívida de curto prazo. Dois fundos têm nomes pouco claros.

feedback.met: Os documentos mostram o que cada fundo busca e possui.

en-US.prompt: Does a good return fix mismatch?
en-US.scene: A learner wants no share exposure. A share fund had excellent recent returns.

options.label: Yes, good returns change its holdings

help: Check what is owned, not just past performance.

feedback.met: Performance does not change the stated exposure mismatch.
feedback.not_yet: Check what is owned, not just past performance.

es-MX.scene: Una persona no quiere exposición a acciones. Un fondo accionario tuvo ganancias recientes excelentes.
help: Revisa lo que posee, no solo resultados pasados.

feedback.met: El rendimiento no cambia la exposición incompatible indicada.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa lo que posee, no solo resultados pasados.

pt-BR.scene: Uma pessoa não quer ações. Um fundo de ações teve ótimos ganhos recentes.
help: Confira o que possui, não só ganhos passados.

feedback.met: O rendimento não muda o risco que a pessoa não queria.
feedback.not_yet: Confira o que possui, não só ganhos passados.

en-US.scene: The goal is several countries. A holds one local company; B spans those countries.
help: Use holdings to check the requested scope.

feedback.met: B’s holdings match the geographic scope requested.

feedback.met: Os ativos de B combinam com os países pedidos.
feedback.not_yet: Use os ativos para conferir o alcance pedido.

help: Revisit contents when the stated strategy changes.

feedback.met: A policy change can alter the exposure being purchased.
feedback.not_yet: Revisit contents when the stated strategy changes.

feedback.not_yet: Reveja o conteúdo quando mudar a estratégia dada.

en-US.scene: A saver wants local-currency debt. A fund’s name sounds local, but it mainly holds foreign-currency shares.

options.label: Yes, the local name is enough

help: Compare the actual mix with both stated constraints.

feedback.met: The holdings differ in both asset type and currency.
feedback.not_yet: Compare the actual mix with both stated constraints.
